title: Beef and Spinach Stuffed Portobellos with Quinoa
intro: Using large portobello caps as edible roasting vessels traps the savory juices of the filling, transforming an everyday ground beef skillet into a simple centerpiece. Serve these mushrooms alongside warm quinoa to soak up every drop of flavor.

ingredients.name: Extra-lean ground beef (96% lean)
ingredients.canonical_name: Beef, ground, 95% lean meat / 5% fat, raw

ingredients.name: No-salt-added diced tomatoes
ingredients.canonical_name: Tomatoes, canned, red, no salt added, diced

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F / 200°C. Place the mushroom caps gill-side up on a baking sheet, brush with olive oil, and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until tender.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add the ground beef, minced garlic, and kosher salt.
Break the meat apart with a spoon and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until browned.
Stir the spinach, diced tomatoes, and dried oregano into the skillet. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the spinach is fully wilted.
Warm the quinoa pouch in the microwave according to the package instructions.
Remove the mushrooms from the oven and carefully drain any excess liquid that pooled inside the caps.
Spoon the hot beef and spinach mixture into the mushroom caps. Top with the crumbled feta and serve alongside the warm quinoa.
variation: Swap the ground beef for extra-lean ground turkey breast.
conservation: Keeps 3 days refrigerated; reheat in the oven or microwave.
